This is the first application under Section 483 of B.N.S.S. for grant of bail in connection with Crime No.141/2024 registered at Police Station Bagsevaniya, District Bhopal (M.P.) for offence punishable under Sections 302, 312, 34, 270, 176, 420 of IPC and Section 5(2), 3, 4 of Medical Termination of Pregnancy Act.

The applicant is in custody since 15.05.2025.
2.
As per the prosecution story, the allegation against present applicant is that she alongwith co-accused committed murder of new born baby in the hospital.
Therefore, offence has been registered against the present applicant under the aforesaid sections.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case.
She is in custody since 15.05.2025.
It is submitted that present applicant is not Doctor and she is NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:50786 2 MCRC-41358-2025 Director of New Pulse Care Hospital, Bhopal.
When present applicant was taken in police remand, at that time, she has not stated anything.
Thereafter, police has prepared another memorandum statement and on the basis of that memorandum, she has been falsely implicated in this case.
It is further submitted that there was no motive to commit murder of new born baby.
Present applicant has not caused any injury to new born baby.
There is no evidence against present applicant that she has committed alleged offence of murder.
Co-accused Nandini Yadav has been enlarged on bail by Coordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 24.03.2025 passed in MCRC.
. Charge sheet has been filed.

The conclusion of the trial will take considerable time,
therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant may be released on bail.
